annotations.title: Compare Indian foods on a nutrient

description: Compare 2-8 Indian foods side by side on a single nutrient (calcium, fibre, iron, protein), returning each food's headline value per 100 g, its other rows, and a source URL. Use this to answer 'which has more protein/iron/fibre'; use lookup_food for one food in depth. Read-only. Foods it cannot match are listed in not_found and the rest are still compared; an unsupported nutrient returns an error naming the valid ones.

foods.description: 2 to 8 food names, e.g. ['rajma', 'chana', 'moong dal']. Unknown names are returned in not_found.

nutrient.description: The nutrient to compare on. Defaults to protein.
